candidates.researchQuestion: When a digital employee resumes after a human interruption, how should reconstructed operator evidence be ordered relative to regenerated or synthetic context?
candidates.title: Resume Recency Is Not Resume Authority
candidates.title_zh: 恢复时序不等于恢复权威
candidates.coreProposition: Resumable agent systems should preserve a monotonic, occurrence-scoped evidence order before model interpretation: once an operator response is reconstructed and admitted for a specific interruption, regenerated context must not silently outrank it, while identity, freshness and exactly-once effects remain separate controls.

sections.heading: A later event can be less authoritative
sections.heading_zh: 更晚的事件，可能更不权威

sections.heading: Enforce precedence before model interpretation
sections.heading_zh: 在模型解释之前落实优先级

sections.heading: The guard is narrow, and the boundary matters
sections.heading_zh: 这条 Guard 很窄，边界也很重要

evidenceClaims.claim: ADK reconstructs user FunctionResponses associated with known interrupt ids into resume inputs.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: ADK 会把与已知 Interrupt ID 关联的 User FunctionResponse 重建为 Resume Input。

evidenceClaims.claim: The workflow-wrapped single-turn input path skips synthetic user-event injection when resume inputs are non-empty.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 当 Resume Input 非空时，Workflow-wrapped Single-turn Input Path 会跳过 Synthetic User Event 注入。

evidenceClaims.claim: The maintainer reports repeated HITL confirmation caused by synthetic input shadowing the operator FunctionResponse.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 维护者报告，Synthetic Input 遮蔽 Operator FunctionResponse 会导致 HITL 重复确认。

evidenceClaims.claim: The regression test verifies a representative non-empty resume-input guard rather than a complete persisted tool-confirmation loop.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Regression Test 验证的是代表性非空 Resume-input Guard，而不是完整持久 Tool-confirmation Loop。

evidenceClaims.claim: Occurrence-scoped resume lineage should determine evidence precedence before model-context assembly.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 面向具体 Occurrence 的 Resume Lineage 应在 Model-context Assembly 前决定 Evidence Precedence。

evidenceClaims.claim: Preserved evidence order does not authenticate the operator or establish exactly-once external effects.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 保留 Evidence Order 不会认证 Operator，也不会建立 Exactly-once External Effect。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general resumable-agent and HITL evidence governance.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already addresses the complete transferable engineering question; a separate community edition would not add a distinct evidence subset or discussion angle.

candidates.researchQuestion: For durable agent work that can be created, forked and resumed, which provenance properties should remain stable across continuation, and which lifecycle transitions may establish a new local provenance identity?
candidates.title: Creation Provenance Should Survive Resume
candidates.title_zh: 创建来源应跨恢复保持稳定
candidates.coreProposition: Durable agent provenance should separate continuation-stable creation source from derivation lineage: ordinary resume must not silently relabel origin, while fork may establish a new local classification and retain its parent relation; neither label becomes authorization without an independent trust binding.

sections.heading: Fork creates a second provenance axis
sections.heading_zh: Fork 会产生第二条 Provenance 轴

sections.heading: A durable label still needs a trust binding
sections.heading_zh: 持久 Label 仍需要 Trust Binding

sections.heading: Compatibility defaults are interpretations
sections.heading_zh: 兼容默认值是一种解释

evidenceClaims.claim: Codex persists User, Subagent, Feature(String) and MemoryConsolidation thread-source classifications, with a compatibility default for missing source.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Codex 持久化 User、Subagent、Feature(String) 与 MemoryConsolidation Thread-source Classification，并为缺失 Source 提供兼容默认值。

evidenceClaims.claim: A fork can establish its own local source classification while retaining parent lineage metadata.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Fork 可以建立自己的 Local Source Classification，同时保留 Parent Lineage Metadata。

evidenceClaims.claim: The inspected TypeScript resume path does not forward a new threadSource when an existing threadId is present.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已检查的 TypeScript Resume Path 在已有 Thread ID 时不会转发新的 threadSource。

evidenceClaims.claim: Arbitrary non-reserved source strings become application-controlled Feature classifications rather than authenticated identities.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 任意非保留 Source String 会成为 Application-controlled Feature Classification，而不是 Authenticated Identity。

evidenceClaims.claim: Creation source should remain stable through ordinary continuation while derivation is represented separately.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Creation Source 应在普通 Continuation 中保持稳定，而 Derivation 应单独表示。

evidenceClaims.claim: A durable provenance label should not acquire authorization power without an independent trust binding.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Durable Provenance Label 在没有独立 Trust Binding 时不应获得 Authorization Power。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general durable-work provenance architecture.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the architecture model; a separate community edition would not add a genuinely different professional angle.

candidates.researchQuestion: When one manager owns resource lifecycle side effects, where should duplicate-resource normalization occur so connect, retry and cleanup remain replayable without overstating the guarantee?
candidates.title: Canonicalize Resources Before Lifecycle Side Effects
candidates.title_zh: 先规范资源，再执行生命周期副作用
candidates.coreProposition: Resource managers should establish one canonical owned population before lifecycle side effects and reuse one documented identity relation across connect, retry and cleanup; deduplication and serialized mutation improve in-process accounting but do not establish endpoint uniqueness or distributed exactly-once execution.

sections.heading: Identity is part of the lifecycle contract
sections.heading_zh: Identity 是 Lifecycle Contract 的一部分

sections.heading: A lock and a unique set solve different failures
sections.heading_zh: Lock 与 Unique Set 解决不同故障

sections.heading: Exactly-once begins beyond the process boundary
sections.heading_zh: Exactly-once 从进程边界之外开始

evidenceClaims.claim: MCPServerManager canonicalizes incoming server entries before establishing lifecycle ownership.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: MCPServerManager 在建立 Lifecycle Ownership 前规范化输入 Server Entry。

evidenceClaims.claim: The uniqueness helper preserves first-occurrence order and uses Python set/equality membership.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Unique Helper 保留 First-occurrence Order，并使用 Python Set/Equality Membership。

evidenceClaims.claim: The repeated-object regression observes one managed entry, one connect and one cleanup, and internal subsets reuse normalization.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Repeated-object Regression 观察到一个 Managed Entry、一次 Connect 与一次 Cleanup，内部 Subset 也复用 Normalization。

evidenceClaims.claim: An asynchronous manager lock serializes participating lifecycle mutation only within one manager process.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Async Manager Lock 只在一个 Manager Process 内串行化参与的 Lifecycle Mutation。

evidenceClaims.claim: Canonicalization should be an ownership-admission invariant shared by all side-effecting lifecycle paths.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Canonicalization 应成为所有 Side-effecting Lifecycle Path 共享的 Ownership-admission Invariant。

evidenceClaims.claim: Local canonicalization and serialization do not establish endpoint uniqueness or distributed exactly-once effects.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Local Canonicalization 与 Serialization 不会建立 Endpoint Uniqueness 或分布式 Exactly-once Effect。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general resource-lifecycle engineering and open-source reliability.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already provides the transferable lifecycle contract; a separate community edition would repeat the same evidence and structure.
